YOU MAY EDIT ONLY: tests/test_game_path_journeys.py and tests/journey_prefix.py. Any other edited file fails the check.

BACKGROUND. Ten cases of `tests/test_game_path_journeys.py::test_every_player_realization_has_an_earned_continuation_to_the_ending[<id>]` fail (ids: k_sl_1a_b_r1, k_sl_1a_f_r2, k_sl_1a_f_r3, k_sl_1a_j_r3, k_sl_1a_k_r1, k_sl_1b_g_r1, k_sl_2a_g_r1, k_sl_2a_h_r1, k_sl_2b_g_r1, k_sl_2c_g_r1) because the scripted playthrough harness is stale. An earlier worker wrote a reviewed fix, saved at `/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/nightly-rest-fix/out/journey-harness.patch`: new `CHAINS` entries, an action-aware replay (`ACTION_COMMANDS`, `_preferred_command`), a legal move to the truck (`_move_to_truck`), and `_rearm_next_chain_storylet`. That last helper edits `state.fired_event_ids` and `state.active_event_ids` by hand to re-arm a storylet, which hid a real engine defect. The engine is now fixed (commit 161145bc): a fired storylet stays offerable for its follow-up realizations (`StoryPackage.follow_up_realization_ids`, which on this story holds SL-1A-F-R2, SL-1A-F-R3 and SL-1A-J-R3).

TASK. Apply the old patch (`git apply /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/nightly-rest-fix/out/journey-harness.patch`). Then delete `_rearm_next_chain_storylet` and every call to it, so the harness never edits `fired_event_ids` or `active_event_ids`. Keep the rest of the patch. If a case then fails, find out why from the engine's offer and fix the harness legally (a real player command, a legal `World.move`, or a `CHAINS` order). Never edit storylet state by hand, and never seed a target outcome fact.
All ten cases must pass. Every other test in the guard files must pass, except the four 3C cases `k_sl_3c_d_r1`, `k_sl_3c_d_r2`, `k_sl_3c_e_r1` and `k_sl_3c_e_r2`, which wait on a story decision and must still fail. Do not touch them.

YOU MAY EDIT ONLY: storygame/runtime/facts.py, tests/test_incident_engine.py and tests/test_fact_store_index.py. Any other edited file fails the check.

BACKGROUND. Commit c32f7ad7 gave `FactStore` (storygame/runtime/facts.py) a private index by predicate (`_by_predicate`), a `version` counter and a cached `KnowledgeGuards`. It rebuilds them in `assert_fact`, `retract_fact`, on assignment to `asserted`, and on construction. But `asserted` is still a plain mutable `set`, so an in-place edit such as `store.asserted.add(fact)` or `store.asserted.discard(fact)` changes the facts without updating the index, the version or the guard cache. `matching()` and every guard built from it then silently return stale answers. `tests/test_incident_engine.py` line 105 does exactly this (`facts.asserted.add(...)`); it passes only because that code path does not read the index.

TASK. Make it impossible for an in-place edit to desync the index. Choose one of these:
(a) Store `asserted` as an immutable `frozenset`. Callers that build or assign a set still work: validate and convert on construction and on assignment. Then an in-place edit raises `AttributeError`.
(b) A small `set` subclass that tells its owning store to rebuild the index and bump the version on every mutating method.
(a) is preferred if the default suite allows it. Keep `matching()` order, every public signature, pydantic validation and serialization (`model_dump`, `model_dump_json`, `model_validate`, `model_validate_json`), `clone`, `model_copy`, snapshot and restore, and equality behaving exactly as now. Change `tests/test_incident_engine.py` line 105 to use `facts.assert_fact(...)`. Add tests to `tests/test_fact_store_index.py` proving the chosen guard: for (a), `asserted.add` raises and the index stays right; for (b), `asserted.add` and `asserted.discard` update `matching()`, `version` and the guard cache.
Behaviour must not change: the persona harness output (`PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp .venv/bin/python -m storygame.personas --out /tmp/p.json`) must stay byte-identical to `/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/persona-speed/baseline/personas.json`, and the whole default suite must pass (`PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 16 tests`, about 3 minutes).
